title: Chapter 1463 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1463 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 2)

Chapter 1463 - 9: Growing Further Apart (Part 2)

"But it's only an influence, nothing much."

Lin Yuan did not care much.

The complete "Innate Five Great" constantly nurtured his mind and willpower.

Moreover, comprehending the other four Chaotic Origin Daos would simultaneously enhance his mind and willpower.

At least for now, the multiple illusions he was enduring didn't significantly affect Lin Yuan.

"Although the difficulty of ascending increased, the guiding effect also surged greatly."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face. Just by stepping onto the first step of the White Jade Step after fusion, he vaguely sensed the imminent comprehension of the Chaotic Origin Taiyi Dao.

By then, possessing the Chaotic Origin Daos represented by two of the Innate Five Great, Lin Yuan's strength would skyrocket further.

The challenge of ascending the White Jade Steps was nothing compared to the rapid growth of Lin Yuan's power.

Several months.

Lin Yuan finally comprehended the direction indicated by the current step.

"For the first phase of the White Jade Steps, I need only a few dozen breaths, at most a few hundred, to climb to the next step. But for the second phase after fusion, I actually need several months for comprehension?"

Lin Yuan gently shook his head.

However, the improvement in guiding his Chaotic Origin Dao was significant enough.

With this thought, Lin Yuan unhesitatingly chose to step onto the next step.

Boom-overwhelming compressive and twisting powers, accompanied by numerous illusions, surged forth.

Time slowly passed.

Fantian Lord paused for a long time before finally stepping onto the next step.

"My Chaotic Origin Dao.." Fantian Lord felt his own Chaotic Origin Dao begin to transform slightly once more, and a smile appeared on his face.

Although the transformation was minor, as long as it could continue transforming, his Chaotic Origin Dao would eventually transform into the Supreme Rule Dao.

"Can these White Jade Steps truly be ascended indefinitely?"

Fantian Lord collected his thoughts and instinctively looked upward at the endless steps.

This was his habit, always glancing upward whenever he stepped onto the next step.

"What is that?"

Fantian Lord's expression grew solemn: "Thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three White Jade Steps drawing together?"

From Fantian Lord's height, he couldn't see the fused White Jade Step, but he could notice the trend of all the White Jade Steps converging.

"Could it be..."

Numerous speculations emerged in Fantian Lord's mind.

Time continued to pass.

Fantian Lord climbed more than enough White Jade Steps once again.

"As I thought."

"Thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three White Jade Steps finally converge into one White Jade Step."

Fantian Lord's gaze was fixed.

This revelation made him realize he could no longer continue climbing so leisurely.

Not long after Fantian Lord vaguely saw that fused White Jade Step, Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang, and other most powerful Legendary

Lords also made the same discovery.

"All White Jade Steps converging?"

"Indeed, that makes sense; otherwise, thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three White Jade Steps, could they all transcend simultaneously?"

Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang, and the other Legendary Lords pondered. Though they realized a fierce battle was imminent for the chance to be the first to step on the fused White Jade Step.

But their hearts felt much more at ease.

If the White Jade Steps continued endlessly and unimpededly allowed

their Chaotic Origin Daos to keep transforming...

Only then would the Legendary Lords feel uneasy.

The higher the realm, the stronger the power, the more they could comprehend a certain essence of the endless dimensional realm.

That is, any gain comes with risks.

Such is the case with infinite origins, infinite tribulations, and Perfect

Time Beings.

The new path of transcendence-the endless White Jade Steps-

should logically be the same.

...

A mystical time-space.

Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, and two other Legendary Lords gathered

in their incarnations.

"If all the White Jade Steps converge, who will be the first to step onto the fused White Jade Step?"

Their acquaintances made the atmosphere subtly oppressive among the Legendary Lords, including Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord.

Everyone knew that taking the lead step-by-step was crucial.

At this moment, whoever stepped onto the fused White Jade Step first would likely maintain their lead.

Then, if there ever was a possibility of birthing a transcendent, it would definitely be this leader.

"Currently, I am the closest to the fused White Jade Step. I should be

the first to step onto it."

Fantian Lord spoke up.

"Being closest doesn't mean stepping on first."

Lord Haotian said calmly. The closer to the fused White Jade Step, the

nearer the distances between each White Jade Step become.

And the nearer they are, the more likely they are to interfere with

each other.

Fantian Lord, being the closest to the fused White Jade Step, was

bound to be hindered by other Legendary Lords.

"Then let's see your strength."

Fantian Lord's gaze was sharp, having long been prepared to battle Lord Haotian and Lord Wan Xiang.

Rumble-

Time and space stirred in waves before the fused White Jade Step.

While climbing the White Jade Steps, Lord Haotian, Lord Wan Xiang, and other Legendary Lords also clashed, trying to hinder each other. "I will definitely be the first to step onto the fused White Jade Step."

Fantian Lord took a step forward, only to be pushed back by the combined efforts of the other three Legendary Lords.

"You all?"

Fantian Lord raged, his terrifying aura shaking time and space.

If this place weren't the sturdy White Jade Steps, just the commotion

from Fantian Lord's attack would have been enough to stir waves of destructive tides in the endless dimensional realm.

Many dimensional spaces and Dimension Heaven and Earth would

face early great destruction because of this.

Rustle.

On a certain White Jade Step.
